name: Etti light cruiser
description: The Etti light cruiser was a small capital ship built by the Corporate Sector Authority, and built off of the same space frame as the Etti-class light transport.

data.name: Etti light cruiser
armament: Quad laser cannon turrets (10; 4 fore, 2 port, 2 starboard, 2 aft)
